record.reason: LongLoRA's efficiency contribution is reducing compute and GPU memory for fine-tuning long-context models using shifted sparse attention and LoRA. The paper explicitly retains full dense attention for inference and says the sparse attention is optional at inference; it presents no inference-time serving or decoding optimization. The workflow excludes training-only efficiency work, so this is unrelated to the current scope.
record.title: LongLoRA: Efficient Fine-tuning of Long-Context Large Language Models
